settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure preferences and manage API keys for external services.

general.languageHint: Choose the language used throughout the editor.
general.compositionHint: Set the canvas dimensions for your project. Pick a preset for TikTok, Reels, YouTube, or enter custom values.
general.editingFrameRateHint: Controls preview playback, frame stepping, and the default export rate. Existing clip timing stays unchanged.
general.backgroundFillHint: Fills the canvas around clips that don't match the aspect ratio.
general.enableAutoSaveHint: Automatically save your project at regular intervals
general.aiConnectionsHint: Connect a compatible endpoint you control. Flameblade Cut does not choose a vendor or model for you.
general.ttsLabel: Text to Speech/Voice To Speech/Sound Effects
general.endpointHint: Enter your API host and the exact tool-capable model ID exposed by that host.
general.modelIdPlaceholder: Enter any model ID from your endpoint
general.modelHint: Load available models from the AI chat settings, or enter an ID manually when discovery is unavailable. API keys are optional.
general.chooseFormatHint: Choose an API format to configure your host and model.
general.aggregatorHint: Video/image generation, upscaling, and creative AI tools

apiKeys.masterSetHint: Your API keys will be encrypted with AES-256-GCM.
apiKeys.unlockedHint: You can now manage API keys.
apiKeys.secureHint: Set up a master password to encrypt and store your API keys locally. Keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and are only sent when making a request to the selected service.
apiKeys.lockedHint: Enter your master password to view and manage API keys.
apiKeys.keychain: Stored securely in the system keychain
apiKeys.pasteOptional: Paste an API key if your endpoint requires one

mcp.tokenRotatedHint: Update your MCP clients with the new token.
mcp.desktopOnlyHint: The MCP server runs inside the Flameblade Cut desktop app, letting external AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline) edit your project. Open Flameblade Cut on desktop to configure it.
mcp.serverHint: A local Model Context Protocol server lets AI clients drive this editor through the same tools as the built-in chat. It listens on loopback only and requires the bearer token below.
mcp.workflowsHint: The live catalog includes focused tools for each desktop workspace.
mcp.wfEditorHint: Tracks, clips, effects, transitions, audio and subtitles
mcp.wfMotionHint: Layers, animation, shaders, masks, effects and render queue
mcp.wfCreationHint: Scenes, products, materials, cameras, rigging and previews
mcp.wfProjectHint: Inspect, import, save, undo, export and diagnostics
mcp.clientSetupHint: Add this to your MCP client config (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline). The shim connects to the running app automatically.
mcp.autoAllowHint: When off, destructive or expensive tool calls over MCP are refused with a confirmation-required notice. Turn on only if you trust every connected local client.

password.min8: Password must be at least 8 characters

password.opFailed: Operation failed. Check your current password.
password.descSetup: Create a master password to encrypt your API keys. This password is never stored — only a verification hash is kept.
password.descUnlock: Enter your master password to access encrypted API keys.
password.descChange: Change your master password. All stored keys will be re-encrypted.
password.pbkdf2: Your password is used to derive an encryption key via PBKDF2 (100k iterations). API keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. If you forget this password, stored keys cannot be recovered.

welcome.title: Welcome to Flameblade Cut
welcome.description: A quick map of the current editor layout: tools on the left, playback in the center, timeline below, and properties on the right.

assets.title: Media and Creative Tools
assets.description: This left panel changes with the tool rail: import media, add text, graphics, effects, and transitions from here.

tips.0: Media holds imported videos, audio, and images
tips.1: Use the left rail to switch to Text, Graphics, Effects, or Transitions
tips.2: Drag assets from this panel onto the timeline
tips.3: The import and record controls live at the top of this panel

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Arrange clips on tracks, trim edges, split selections, and use the zoom controls on the right side of the timeline bar.

tips.0: Press S to split the selected clip
tips.2: Use Add track when you need another video or audio lane

preview.title: Player
preview.description: The center player shows the current frame and playback controls. Crop, fit, and review changes here before export.

tips.0: Use playback controls under the canvas
tips.1: The green dot means live preview is active
tips.2: Fullscreen and fit tools are in the player controls

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.description: Select a clip to edit its properties. Transform, color, effects, speed, and animation controls appear here.

tips.0: Use the top tabs to switch between property groups
tips.1: Color grading and effects are clip-specific
tips.2: Keyframe-capable controls show animation options when a clip is selected

complete.title: You're Ready
complete.description: You now know where the main tools live. Use the action rail on the far left to reopen tours, settings, and project utilities.
